stage: real VLM construction and heterogeneous-cost feasibility

established: Arbitrary sparse global visual fusion is unsafe because an incomplete visual support is not a complete-corpus ranking.
A query-scope closed high-fidelity cohort preserves the selected cascade quality regardless of whether cohort pages are persistent or transient.
Both held-out domains contain a stable defer-partial-full cumulative-work phase under history-frequency materialization.
On an RTX 5090, persistent closure pages reduce mean high-fidelity candidate execution latency by 31.0% and 34.0% in the two evaluated domains.
Real Omni page construction costs 0.247 seconds/page on Pharmaceuticals and 0.261 seconds/page on Industrial in sampled end-to-end runs; the estimates agree with complete build time within 5.8%.

After charging a DVI-like raw-page verifier for image I/O, preprocessing, H2D, and model forward, history-frequency closure materialization has a non-empty visual-compute cost-winning region in both domains.

On identical H-Pool Top-20 candidates, the query-conditioned raw-page verifier beats persistent Omni reranking in both domains, exposing a quality-versus-reuse trade-off rather than equivalent representations.
Caching query-independent Qwen2.5-VL vision-tower output preserves verifier scores exactly on the 256-pair pilots while reducing the query-side GPU path by about 77% end to end in both domains.
At a 5% persistent-page budget, the exact-quality raw-partial-full feature-cache phase is stable over the real order and five random query orders in both domains.
not_yet_established: The phase transfers unchanged to an unseen domain or a natural production trace.
The current quality beats the strongest complete hybrid index on every domain.
A deployable page-value predictor closes the substantial future-frequency oracle gap, especially on Pharmaceuticals.
DVI-like timing is fully optimized over batch size and last-token computation; the current complete-chain measurement uses batch size four and computes full sequence logits.
The exact score-equivalence and timing gains hold over complete benchmark query sets and production-like concurrent serving rather than the current 256-pair pilots.
The visual-feature cache remains advantageous after optimized batching, storage I/O, invalidation, and an unseen-domain transfer.
The method is novel relative to current multimodal prefix/vision-feature caching and deferred-ingestion systems after a dedicated literature audit.

global_sparse_fusion_failure.interpretation: The future oracle proves headroom, while history/static selectors fail because page value is query-conditional and sparse columns create ranking interference.

physical_gpu_runtime.scope: RTX 5090; query H2D, selected Full tensor H2D, and exact MaxSim; raw-page decode and VLM construction excluded
physical_gpu_runtime.interpretation: H2D dominates exact candidate MaxSim. Mean and median improve strongly, while smaller p95 gains expose low-hit queries as the next bottleneck.

real_vlm_construction_and_dvi_cost.scope: RTX 5090; real raw-page pipelines. Omni includes image decode, upstream processor, input H2D, encode_passage, and output D2H. DVI-like includes image decode, query-image preprocessing, H2D, and Qwen2.5-VL-3B forward.
real_vlm_construction_and_dvi_cost.interpretation: The defer-partial-full visual-compute phase survives measured heterogeneous costs and is stronger than the forward-only lower-bound calculation. It is not yet an equal-quality Pareto claim because query-time raw-page verification ranks better than persistent Omni on identical candidates. Selection quality controls the width of the partial region: the future-frequency oracle creates a Pharmaceuticals Top-20 region at 5% pages, while history frequency needs 10%.

paired_quality_boundary.scope: same deterministic 100-query cohort per domain; H-Pool routes use identical Top-20 candidate sets but different scoring semantics
paired_quality_boundary.interpretation: A raw-page verifier behind BM25 is already quality-competitive with persistent Full representations. On the exact same H-Pool Top-20 candidates it improves nDCG@10 by 0.0294 on Pharmaceuticals and 0.0132 on Industrial relative to Full Omni reranking. ReprForge therefore needs a persistent state that retains query-conditioned visual judgment, or must explicitly optimize the quality-latency trade-off; persistence cannot be claimed to universally preserve quality.

query_conditioned_visual_feature_materia.representation: host-resident Qwen2.5-VL vision-tower output after the multimodal projector; the query-conditioned language model still executes online
query_conditioned_visual_feature_materia.quality_contract: raw and cached paths execute the same verifier language layers; maximum YES-minus-NO score difference was 0.0 on each 256-pair domain pilot
query_conditioned_visual_feature_materia.comparison_to_omni_storage: The measured cached feature is about 5.05-5.08 MB/page versus about 11.3 MB/page for the current Full Omni multivector output, but the cached feature is a verifier intermediate rather than a standalone retrieval index.
query_conditioned_visual_feature_materia.interpretation: This is the first equal-quality materialization result in the current study. It supports a representation state machine: complete cheap locator, deferred raw page, selectively materialized visual feature, and optionally an approximate low-latency retrieval representation. The current result is a small physical pilot, not yet a paper-scale method claim.

nearest_prior_work_boundary.MPIC: Already stores multimodal KV caches on local disks and combines reuse with recomputation for position-independent MLLM serving; therefore persistent multimodal cache storage is not itself novel.
nearest_prior_work_boundary.VLCache: Already combines encoder and KV cache reuse for repeated multimodal inputs with layer-aware recomputation; therefore vision-feature reuse is not itself novel.
nearest_prior_work_boundary.DVI: Already defers raw-page visual understanding until a query after cheap page localization; therefore zero visual pre-ingestion is not itself novel.
nearest_prior_work_boundary.EdgeRAG: Already selects and adaptively caches regenerable embeddings under edge memory constraints; therefore online embedding materialization is not itself novel.
nearest_prior_work_boundary.reprforge_required_delta: The publishable unit must be the multimodal RAG compiler problem and method: jointly choose locator coverage and per-page representation state under ingestion, storage, repeated-query latency, and retrieval-quality constraints, with workload transfer evidence. The current exact-quality phase is enabling evidence, not yet sufficient novelty.

protocol.history_evaluation_split: frozen 4/5 history and 1/5 evaluation query hash split
protocol.persistent_selector: top page incidence frequency on history candidate closures only
protocol.high_fidelity_operation: exact Full Omni MaxSim over the complete query candidate cohort
